ruled_out_vectors.vector: Malicious pool type returns fake amounts to steal from LPs
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Pool type swapByInput return values constrained by _safeDecrementUint128 on pool reserves (AMMModule.sol:1437). amountOut > reserve causes revert. Balance check at AMMModule.sol:2208 validates actual token receipt.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Malicious transfer handler skips actual transfer
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Balance check at AMMModule.sol:2208 ensures balanceInBefore + amountIn == balanceInAfter. Handler must actually transfer tokens to AMM. Both CLOB and Permit handlers validate msg.sender == AMM.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Direct handler call bypassing AMM hooks
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: CLOBTransferHandler.ammHandleTransfer() checks msg.sender != AMM at line 230. PermitTransferHandler.ammHandleTransfer() checks at line 115. Cannot be called directly.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Malicious pool hook manipulates price to extract from swappers
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Pool hook set by pool creator at creation. Users who swap in pool chose to trust it. Tier B - requires custom handler. Reserve decrements still apply. SingleProviderPoolType validates sqrtPriceX96 bounds (SingleProviderPoolType.sol:328-330).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Pool type address collision via 6 leading zero bytes mining
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Pool IDs deterministic from params. poolInitialized[poolId] prevents duplicates. Different pool type address = different pool ID. 2^112 address space makes collision infeasible.
Not UUPS/beacon pattern. SecureProxy is EIP-1967 with admin-controlled upgrades. Initialization in constructor (SecureProxy.sol:87-92). Architecture mismatch.
Not a diamond with dynamic facets. LimitBreakAMM uses fixed immutable module addresses (LimitBreakAMM.sol:35-41). No facet management or selector routing.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: CREATE2 destroy and redeploy at same address
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: selfdestruct deprecated in Cancun EVM. No self-destruct in any contract. Not possible on target EVM version.
No facet management exists. Module addresses are immutable constructor parameters. Cannot add/replace modules post-deployment.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Malicious ICLOBHook via groupKey blocks/steals from CLOB users
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Anyone can create order books with any hook in groupKey. But users choose which order book to interact with. Malicious hook only affects its own order book (Tier B, self-inflicted).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: feeOnTop not signed in permit - executor steals from signer
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Known Low finding. feeOnTop not in SWAP_TYPEHASH (Constants.sol:35). But limitAmount IS signed and caps minimum output. Signer protected by their own limitAmount choice.

Known Low (CP-003). computeRatioX96 returns 0 on overflow. Direct swap path now reverts on sqrtPriceX96==0 (AMMStandardHook.sol:847-850). validateHandlerOrder still vulnerable when minSqrtPriceX96 not set, but impact limited.

Known Low (CP-001). DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT written in beforeSwap, read in afterSwap, never cleared. Requires beforeSwap flag disabled + afterSwap enabled in same tx. By-design transient storage pattern.
_requireCallerIsRegistry() checks msg.sender == address(SETTINGS_REGISTRY). SETTINGS_REGISTRY is immutable, set in constructor. No bypass path.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Token creator syncs settings to arbitrary hooks
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: setTokenSettings caller controls hooksToSync array, but can only update settings for their OWN token. Token-scoped, no cross-token effect. By design.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Multi-hop cross-pool drain via malicious pool type
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Per-pool reserves + _safeDecrementUint128 (AMMModule.sol:1437). Malicious pool in hop 1 can only move tokens from its own reserves. Net effect: self-trading. No cross-pool extraction.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Storage-slot collision via external call to extensions
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All extensions (pool types, hooks, handlers) called via call not delegatecall. They execute in their own storage context, cannot access AMM diamond storage at slot 0x9A1D.

theft_theses.thesis: Register malicious pool type -> users swap -> pool type returns inflated amountOut -> steal from pool reserves
theft_theses.victim: LPs who add liquidity to the malicious pool

theft_theses.thesis: Deploy malicious transfer handler -> executor specifies handler in transferData -> handler skips token transfer but AMM believes funds arrived
Call hook directly (not via AMM) -> credited without legitimate swap -> extract tokens
